<script setup lang="ts">
import { AnimatedSidebarProvider } from "../../../motion/animated-sidebar";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import ShellFit from "./ShellFit.vue";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    open?: boolean;
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    openMobile?: boolean;
    defaultOpenMobile?: boolean;
    mobileOpen?: boolean;
    defaultMobileOpen?: boolean;

  }>(),

    defaultOpenMobile: undefined,

    collapseSidebarBelow: 600,

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:open": [open: boolean];
  openChange: [open: boolean];
  "update:openMobile": [open: boolean];
  openMobileChange: [open: boolean];
  "update:mobileOpen": [open: boolean];
}>();
function desktop(value: boolean) {

  emit("openChange", value);
}
function mobile(value: boolean) {
  emit("update:openMobile", value);
  emit("openMobileChange", value);
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { useAnimatedSidebar } from "../../../motion/animated-sidebar";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ minWidth?: number }>(), {
  minWidth: 600,
});
const anchor = ref<HTMLElement>();
const sidebar = useAnimatedSidebar();
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;
let alive = false;
function subscribe() {
  observer?.disconnect();
  const shell = anchor.value?.parentElement;
  if (!alive || !shell || typeof ResizeObserver === "undefined") return;
  let previous: boolean | undefined;
  observer = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
    const width = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;
    if (width === undefined) return;
    const compact = width < props.minWidth;
    if (compact === previous) return;
    const initial = previous === undefined;
    previous = compact;
    if (initial && !compact) return;
    if (sidebar.open.value === compact) sidebar.open.value = !compact;
  });
  observer.observe(shell);
}
watch(() => props.minWidth, subscribe);
onMounted(() => {
  alive = true;
  subscribe();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  alive = false;
  observer?.disconnect();
});
</script>
<template><div ref="anchor" class="hidden" /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";
const props = defineProps<{
  citationId: string;
  index: number;
  idPrefix: string;
  label?: string;
}>();
const targetId = computed(
  () => `${props.idPrefix}-${props.citationId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "-")}`,
);
let pending: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
function reveal(event: MouseEvent) {
  const row = document.getElementById(targetId.value);
  if (!row) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  row
    .closest("[data-citations]")
    ?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('button[aria-expanded="false"]')
    ?.click();
  if (pending !== undefined) clearTimeout(pending);
  pending = setTimeout(() => {
    if (!row.isConnected) return;
    row.scrollIntoView?.({
      behavior: matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches
        ? "instant"
        : "smooth",
      block: "nearest",
    });
    row.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }, 50);
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (pending !== undefined) clearTimeout(pending);
});
</script>
<template>

    :href="`#${targetId}`"
    :aria-label="label || `View citation ${index}`"
    @click="reveal"
    class="mx-0.5 inline-flex min-w-4 -translate-y-0.5 items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted/60 px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold leading-none text-muted-foreground no-underline outline-none transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { createDitherField } from "./dither";
import type { ImageGenerationStatus } from "./ImageGeneration.vue";
const props = defineProps<{
  status: ImageGenerationStatus;
  interactive: boolean;
  reduce: boolean;
}>();
const canvas = ref<HTMLCanvasElement>();
const opacity = computed(() =>
  props.status === "refining"
    ? 0.48
    : props.status === "queued" || props.status === "generating"
      ? 1
      : 0,
);
let release: (() => void) | undefined;
let capabilities: MediaQueryList | undefined;
let ready = false;
function refresh() {
  release?.();
  release = undefined;
  if (ready && canvas.value)
    release = createDitherField(
      canvas.value,
      props.interactive,
      props.reduce,
      capabilities?.matches ?? false,
    );
}
watch([() => props.interactive, () => props.reduce], refresh);
onMounted(() => {
  ready = true;
  capabilities = matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
  capabilities.addEventListener("change", refresh);
  refresh();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  ready = false;
  release?.();
  capabilities?.removeEventListener("change", refresh);
});
</script>
<template>

    aria-hidden="true"
    class="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden bg-muted"
    :initial="false"
    :animate="{ opacity }"
    :transition="{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.4, ease: EASE_OUT }"
  >

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, provide, ref, type Component } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { bubbleKey, bubbleLayoutKey } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });

    align: "start" as const,
    variant: "soft" as const,
    animateIn: false,

);

  revision.value++;
});
const variants = {
  solid: "bg-foreground",
  soft: "bg-muted",
  tint: "bg-muted",
  outline: "border border-border/70 bg-background",
  ghost: "",
  danger: "bg-destructive/10",
};
const classes = computed(() =>
  cn(
    context.value.variant === "solid" && "text-background",
    context.value.variant === "danger" && "text-destructive",
    context.value.variant === "ghost" &&
      "w-full max-w-none rounded-none px-0 py-0",
    ["button", "a"].includes(props.as as string) &&
      "cursor-pointer text-left outline-none transition-[background-color,color,transform] duration-150 hover:brightness-[0.98] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring active:scale-[0.99]",
  ),
);
</script>

    data-slot="message-bubble-content"
    v-bind="$attrs"
    :class="
      cn(

        $attrs.class,

    "

    <motion.span

      aria-hidden="true"
      :layout="reduced ? false : 'size'"
      :layout-dependency="revision"
      :initial="

      :class="
        cn(

          context.align === 'end'
            ? 'origin-bottom-right'
            : 'origin-bottom-left',
          variants[context.variant],
        )
      "
    />
    <motion.div
      class="relative"
      :initial="context.animateIn ? { opacity: 0 } : false"
      :animate="{ opacity: 1 }"
      :transition="{
        duration: 0.12,
        ease: EASE_OUT,
        delay: reduced ? 0 : 0.04,
      }"
      ><slot
    /></motion.div>

</template>

<script setup lang="ts">

<script setup lang="ts">

import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";

  ["Helpful", "Not helpful"].includes(props.label) ? props.active : undefined,
);

  <motion.button
    type="button"
    :aria-label="label"
    :title="label"
    :aria-pressed="pressed"
    :while-press="reduced ? undefined : { scale: 0.9 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS"
    :class="
      cn(
        'grid size-7 place-items-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        active && 'bg-muted text-foreground',
      )
    "
    ><slot
  /></motion.button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { EASE_OUT, SPRING_LAYOUT } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
import type { TodoItemStatus } from "./TodoList.vue";
const props = defineProps<{ status: TodoItemStatus; progress?: number }>();
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const advancing = computed(() => props.status === "in-progress");
const indeterminate = computed(
  () => advancing.value && props.progress === undefined && !reduced.value,
);
const fraction = computed(() =>
  props.progress === undefined
    ? 0.68
    : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, props.progress)) / 100,
);
const strokeThrough = (points: readonly (readonly [number, number])[]) =>
  points.map(([x, y], index) => `${index ? "L" : "M"}${x} ${y}`).join("");
// Own normalized status marks, independent of the earlier copied path strings.
const marks = [
  {
    state: "completed",
    path: strokeThrough([
      [7.8, 12],
      [10.7, 15],
      [16.4, 9.3],
    ]),
    duration: 0.24,
  },
  {
    state: "cancelled",
    path:
      strokeThrough([
        [8.8, 8.8],
        [15.2, 15.2],
      ]) +
      strokeThrough([
        [15.2, 8.8],
        [8.8, 15.2],
      ]),
    duration: 0.2,
  },
];
</script>
<template>
  <motion.svg
    aria-hidden="true"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    :initial="false"
    :class="
      cn(
        'mx-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 overflow-visible text-muted-foreground',
        advancing && 'text-foreground',
        status === 'cancelled' && 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400',
      )
    "

    <motion.circle
      cx="12"
      cy="12"
      r="9"
      fill="currentColor"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="1.5"
      :stroke-dasharray="status === 'pending' ? '2 3' : undefined"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{ fillOpacity: status === 'completed' ? 0.06 : 0 }"
      :transition="
        reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE_OUT }
      "
      :class="advancing && 'opacity-20'"
    />
    <motion.circle
      cx="12"
      cy="12"
      r="9"
      pathLength="1"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        pathLength: advancing ? fraction : 0,
        opacity: Number(advancing),
        rotate: indeterminate ? 360 : -90,
      }"
      :transition="
        indeterminate
          ? { rotate: { duration: 1.1, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' } }
          : reduced
            ? { duration: 0 }
            : SPRING_LAYOUT
      "
      :style="{ transformOrigin: '12px 12px' }"
    />
    <motion.path
      v-for="mark in marks"
      :key="mark.state"
      :d="mark.path"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      :stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      :initial="false"
      :animate="{
        pathLength: Number(status === mark.state),
        opacity: Number(status === mark.state),
      }"
      :transition="
        reduced ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: mark.duration, ease: EASE_OUT }
      "
    />
  </motion.svg>
</template>
